mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates for equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS on 20-day returns is negative or below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) is negative or below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or positive 60-day returns occur in less than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1100 and RSAFS > 450.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), a further decline in unemployment signals overheating and potential inflation, leading to aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening economic activity, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO on 20-day returns is positive in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% annualized (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a stable monetary environment, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for the interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) is negative or below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or positive 20-day returns occur in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: In a high job growth phase (PAYEMS growth > 200k per month), strong labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k per month.
